content: Purview Unified Catalog vs Data Map: Data Map scans sources and captures technical metadata/collections; Unified Catalog is where governance domains are built and data products curated. Governance domain = boundary for common governance/ownership/discovery of data products and glossary terms, mapped to business areas (e.g. Marketing, Finance). Data product = named business concept with owners + list of associated data assets, lives in one governance domain, discoverable across domains.
